about: Fire up a wild ride across the cosmos with a fresh take on Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy. In this action-adventure game, you are Star-Lord leading the unpredictable Guardians from one explosion of chaos to the next. You got this. Probably.
Become Star-Lord and call the shots for the Guardians in and out of battle.
Face a cosmic threat you unleashed in this fresh take on Guardians of the Galaxy.
